info.name: RamDhan API — Slider Module
info.description:
Slider Module collection (Admin + Storefront).

## Envelope
Every response follows the app-wide envelope:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "...",
  "data": {},
  "errors": null,
  "meta": null
}
```

Paginated lists put paginator info into `meta`: `current_page`, `last_page`, `per_page`, `total`, `from`, `to`.

## Variables (auto-wired)
- `base_url` — host only, paths already contain `/api/v1/...`
- `token` — set automatically by **Setup & Auth › Login** (Bearer)
- `slider_code` — storefront code, default `home_hero`
- `slider_uuid` / `item_uuid` / `media_uuid` — captured automatically from List/Show/Create responses

## Flow
1. Run **Login** (needs an admin role user — super-admin/admin own all `slider.*` permissions)
2. Run admin endpoints top-to-bottom — ids chain automatically
3. Storefront calls need no token

item.name: Setup & Auth
item.description: Run Login first — it stores the Bearer token into the `token` collection variable automatically. The user must belong to a role with `slider.*` permissions (super-admin / admin have all of them).

exec: console.log('Bearer token saved to collection variable: token');

request.description:
`POST /api/v1/auth/login`

Returns `{ data: { user, token } }` — the test script saves `data.token` into the collection's `token` variable used by all admin requests.

item.name: Storefront (Public)
item.description:
Public endpoints — no authentication.

`GET /api/v1/storefront/sliders/{code}`

Returns the slider only when `is_active = true`; otherwise `404`. Inside the slider, `active_items` contains only items that are active AND inside their schedule window (`starts_at <= now <= ends_at`, null bounds are open-ended). Admin-side fields like every `items` list is hidden here by design.

request.description:
`GET /api/v1/storefront/sliders/home_hero`

`slider_code` variable defaults to `home_hero`. Seeded codes: `home_hero`, `home_secondary`. Change the variable (or paste another code in the URL) to render other placements.

item.name: Get Slider By Code - Not Found Case

request.description:
`GET /api/v1/storefront/sliders/does_not_exist`

Expected response:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Resource not found.",
  "data": null,
  "errors": null,
  "meta": null
}
```

HTTP `404` — same when the slider code exists but `is_active = false`.

exec: console.log('slider_uuid set to first row: ' + json.data[0].code);

query.description: One of: name | code | placement | is_active | created_at | updated_at
Free-text search across name, code, placement (LIKE %term%) — enable to use
Filter by name (LIKE %value%) — enable to use
Filter by code (LIKE %value%) — enable to use
Filter by placement (LIKE %value%) — enable to use
Filter by status: 1 = active, 0 = inactive — enable to use

request.description:
`GET /api/v1/sliders`

**Pagination** → `page`, `per_page` (10–100)

**Search** → `search=` matches name OR code OR placement

**Filters** (bracket array params):
| Param | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `filters[name]` | LIKE `%value%` |
| `filters[code]` | LIKE `%value%` |
| `filters[placement]` | LIKE `%value%` |
| `filters[status]` | boolean cast → exact `is_active` |

**Sort** → `sort_by` whitelist `name|code|placement|is_active|created_at|updated_at`; invalid values fall back to `created_at desc`.

Rows include nested `items` (each with its `images` gallery); paginator info in `meta`.

`POST /api/v1/sliders` → HTTP `201`.

| Field | Rules |
|---|---|
| `name` | required, max:150 |
| `code` | required, max:100, unique, regex `^[a-z0-9_]+$` |
| `placement` | nullable, max:100 (`home`, `product`, ...) |
| `is_active` | optional boolean |

Test script stores the new UUID into `slider_uuid` for chaining.

`GET /api/v1/sliders/{uuid}`

Full admin view — ALL items (`items`) ordered by `sort_order`, each with its `images` gallery. First item's uuid is captured into `item_uuid`.

`PUT /api/v1/sliders/{uuid}`

All fields optional (partial update):
- `name` max:150
- `code` unique, regex `^[a-z0-9_]+$` (ignores own row when unchanged)
- `placement` max:100
- `is_active` boolean

`PATCH /api/v1/sliders/{uuid}/status`

Body: `{ "is_active": true|false }` (required boolean). Deactivating a slider immediately hides it from the storefront endpoint.

`DELETE /api/v1/sliders/{uuid}`

Soft-deletes the slider. Its items remain attached for restore.

`POST /api/v1/sliders/{uuid}/restore`

Restores a soft-deleted slider (requires `slider.restore`). Only works on trashed rows — an active slider returns `404` since the route model binding excludes trashed by default.

Run **Delete** before this one when testing the pair.

item.name: Admin › Slider Items
item.description:
Nested under a slider — every item route requires `slider.update`:

- `POST   /api/v1/sliders/{slider_uuid}/items`
- `PUT    /api/v1/sliders/{slider_uuid}/items/{item_uuid}`
- `DELETE /api/v1/sliders/{slider_uuid}/items/{item_uuid}`

There is no dedicated item list endpoint — items come nested inside Show Slider / List Sliders responses ordered by `sort_order`. Item images attach via the Media module (`collection = slider`) using the Media › Upload request.

body.raw:
{
    "title": "RamDhan Mega Sale",
    "subtitle": "Up to 50% off everything",
    "button_text": "Shop Now",
    "button_url": "/products",
    "sort_order": 0,
    "is_active": true,
    "starts_at": null,
    "ends_at": null
}

request.description:
`POST /api/v1/sliders/{slider_uuid}/items` → HTTP `201`

| Field | Rules |
|---|---|
| `title` | **required**, max:191 |
| `subtitle` | nullable, max:255 |
| `button_text` | nullable, max:100 |
| `button_url` | nullable, max:500 |
| `sort_order` | optional integer ≥ 0 |
| `is_active` | optional boolean |
| `starts_at` | nullable, `Y-m-d H:i:s` — schedule start |
| `ends_at` | nullable, `Y-m-d H:i:s`, must be ≥ `starts_at` |

Scheduling example:
```json
"starts_at": "2026-08-01 00:00:00",
"ends_at":   "2026-08-31 23:59:59"
```
Outside the window the item never appears in storefront `active_items`. New uuid is captured into `item_uuid`.

`PUT /api/v1/sliders/{slider_uuid}/items/{item_uuid}`

Same fields as create, all optional (partial update). `starts_at`/`ends_at` accept the same `Y-m-d H:i:s` format with the `after_or_equal:starts_at` rule. Responds with the fresh item including its `images` gallery.

`DELETE /api/v1/sliders/{slider_uuid}/items/{item_uuid}`

Removes a single slide from the slider.

Run this **after** finishing item/media tests — once deleted, `item_uuid` no longer resolves (404 on further calls).

item.name: Media (attach slider images)
item.description:
Slider images live in the shared `media` table:

- Slider-level image → `mediable_type=slider`, `mediable_uuid={{slider_uuid}}`
- Slide (item) image → `mediable_type=slider_item`, `mediable_uuid={{item_uuid}}`, `collection=slider`

Upload through `POST /api/v1/media` (multipart). The uploaded row attaches to the model immediately — no separate attach call needed.

formdata.description: Required — max 10MB; mimes: jpg, jpeg, png, webp, gif, svg, pdf, doc(x), xls(x), mp4, mov
One of: product | category | brand | user | slider | slider_item — use slider_item for slide banners
UUID of the owning model — the created slider item's uuid (from Create Slider Item)
Gallery bucket — use `slider` for slider images

request.description:
`POST /api/v1/media` — multipart/form-data. Uploads the file to `storage/app/public/media/...` and attaches it to `App\Modules\Slider\Models\SliderItem` in one call.

For a **slider-level** image instead: set `mediable_type=slider` and `mediable_uuid={{slider_uuid}}`.

After upload, re-run **Show Slider / Get Slider By Code** — the image appears under the item's `images` array with its public `url`. Captured uuid lands in `media_uuid`.

query.description: Rows per page — min:10, max:100 (standard list request)

request.description:
`GET /api/v1/media`

Paginated media library. Each row: `uuid`, `original_name`, `file_name`, `url`, `mime_type`, `size`, `title`, `alt_text`, `type`, `sort_order`, `is_primary`, `mediable_type`, `mediable_id`, `collection`.
`GET /api/v1/media/{uuid}` — single media row with its resolved public `url`.
`PUT /api/v1/media/{uuid}` — update metadata (`title`, `alt_text`, `description`, `sort_order`, ...). The binary file is not replaced.
`PATCH /api/v1/media/{uuid}/primary` — flags this media as the primary image of its parent (`is_primary = 1`).
`DELETE /api/v1/media/{uuid}` — soft-deletes the media row. Run last in the media flow; further calls with the same uuid return 404 unless restored.
`POST /api/v1/media/{uuid}/restore` — restores a soft-deleted media row. Run after Delete Media when you want to recover it.
`DELETE /api/v1/media/{uuid}/force` — permanently removes the media row and its file from disk. Irreversible.
